subject: Export options for audit trail bulk delivery (regulatory package)
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@stf-pharma.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: compliance@stf-pharma.com
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Export requirements for upcoming regulatory submission

Hi Evelyn,

We need some help preparing an export of audit/access logs to include in an upcoming regulatory submission. Two quick asks:  

1) What bulk export options do you support for audit trails (formats, delivery targets, region controls)? We need a signed manifest and checksums as part of the package.
2) Can you confirm retention windows and whether exported artifacts retain residency (i.e., if we request EU-region exports, do the files remain in EU storage)?

Context: STF Pharmaceuticals must submit event-level access logs covering the past 24 months to a EU regulator. They expect a packaged bundle (logs + manifest + checksum) and evidence of deletion requests after the package is produced.

Attachments: sample_request_schema.csv (attached by request)

Thanks — can you send a short options matrix and estimate for a one-time export of 24 months of audit data? If helpful we can jump on a 30m call.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of Compliance
STF Pharmaceuticals

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@stf-pharma.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Export requirements for upcoming regulatory submission

Hi Marta — thanks for the details. Quick summary of supported export paths and guarantees; I put the options below so you can pick what fits your audit needs. I attached a short PDF matrix and a sample manifest.

Option A — Direct, signed S3 delivery (recommended for regulator packages)- Format: gzipped JSONL or compressed CSV per day- Delivery target: customer-owned S3 bucket (we support AWS EU regions: eu-west-1, eu-central-1)- Residency: data exported to the customer bucket remains in-region; we never route that export outside the selected region- Integrity: we produce a signed manifest + SHA256 checksums for each object- Timeline: 24 months export (event-level) estimate ~ 6–10 hours depending on window and retention of full request/response payloads

Option B — Redbox managed snapshot (temporary download link)- Format: single tar.gz with manifest and index CSV- Delivery target: short-lived, pre-signed HTTPS link hosted in EU (72h validity)- Use case: ad-hoc regulator download; we do not recommend for long-term archival

Option C — API streaming extraction (for incremental retrieval)- Use when you want to pull segments and validate in your environment; requires engineering coordination

Retention and deletion notes:- Exported objects are written to your chosen target; compliance with residency is preserved by writing to a region-specific bucket.- If you need us to perform a deletion sweep on our side (remove intermediate export snapshots, temp caches), we will run an audit export cleanup and provide a signed deletion certificate.

Security & provenance:- All exports are encrypted in transit and at rest using customer-managed keys (optional) or Redwood-managed KMS.- We can include HSM-backed signatures for manifests on request (SOC2 evidence).

Next steps I need from you to scope a firm estimate:
1) Confirm exact event types required (auth events, admin console actions, API key changes, model access logs — if you want everything we default to the full audit dataset)
2) Confirm preferred delivery method (Option A preferred) and target region/bucket details
3) Let us know whether you require HSM-signed manifests

Attachments: audit_export_options_v1.pdf; sample_export_manifest.csv

If you want to run a test export for a 30-day window first, Monica can kick that off — she is cc'ed. Otherwise Karthik will own the S3 coordination. Happy to schedule a 30-minute sync; propose Tue 2026-12-02 09:00 PST / 18:00 CET.

Thanks,

Evelyn Hart
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@stf-pharma.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: compliance@stf-pharma.com
Date: 2026-12-01T15:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Export requirements for upcoming regulatory submission

Evelyn — this is very helpful, thanks.

We will take Option A (direct S3 delivery in eu-west-1) and want the full audit dataset (auth, admin, API access, console, and policy changes) for the last 24 months. We do require SHA256 checksums and a signed manifest (HSM signing would be a plus).

Two clarifications:
1) Can you provide a sample manifest layout so our auditors can preview? (I saw the sample attached but can you confirm column headers and example rows)
2) If the export runs for 6–10 hours, is there any impact to production latency or throttling we should expect?

Also please go ahead with a short 30-day test export while you scope the full job — we want to see the manifest & checksum format before committing the full run.

If you can start the test export tomorrow, that would be ideal.

—Marta

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@stf-pharma.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Export requirements for upcoming regulatory submission

Thanks Marta — we can start the 30-day test export tomorrow morning (EU window). Monica will run the export and attach the manifest + checksums to the Drive folder; Karthik will provision an IAM role for your S3 bucket and confirm the eu-west-1 write location. Neither the export snapshot nor the background job will affect production latency — exports read from the audit event store and are throttled to prioritize serving traffic; we will not change serving capacity.

Action items: 
- Monica: run 30-day export and upload manifest (due 2026-12-03 16:00 CET)
- Karthik: create cross-account role + provide bucket write instructions (due 2026-12-03 12:00 CET)
- Evelyn: share signed manifest options and HSM signing process doc (attached)

I'll book the 30m sync for Tue 2026-12-02 09:00 PST as suggested — invite sent.

Evelyn

--
Evelyn Hart
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
